The '''M-300 hunting blaster''' was a popular [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], who produced more of these hunting blasters than any other company.
